WITH CURRENCY_LST AS
     (SELECT NVL(FSP.ORG_ID, -99) ORG_ID,
             GSB.CURRENCY_CODE
     FROM    FINANCIALS_SYSTEM_PARAMS_ALL FSP,
             GL_SETS_OF_BOOKS GSB
     WHERE   FSP.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID = GSB.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
     )
     ,
     PR_DATE AS
     (SELECT  PO_ACTION_HISTORY.OBJECT_ID,
              MAX(
                       CASE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'APPROVE'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       END) LAST_APPROVED_DATE,
              MIN(
                       CASE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'SUBMIT'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'IMPORT'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       END) LAST_SUBMIT_DATE
     FROM     PO_ACTION_HISTORY
     WHERE    PO_ACTION_HISTORY.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQUISITION'
     AND      PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE IN ('APPROVE',
                                                'SUBMIT' ,
                                                'IMPORT')
     GROUP BY OBJECT_ID
     )

PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.RECREATE_DEMAND_FLAG
	   
       FROM 
	 (
	    (SELECT
		    LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	    FROM    PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL,
		    PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL HEADERS_ALL
	    WHERE   LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
	    AND     HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    
	    UNION ALL
	    
	    SELECT
		   LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	    FROM   PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL,
		   PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL HEADERS_ALL
	    WHERE  LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
	    AND    HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE    < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    AND    LINES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE     >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    )
	 
	 UNION
	 
	 SELECT
		LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	 FROM   (	 
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL,
		PO_RELEASES_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID       = PO_RELEASES_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID
	 AND    LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE    < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 AND    PO_RELEASES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 
	 UNION ALL
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL,
		PO_HEADERS_ALL                     ,
		PO_LINES_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_LINE_ID  = PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID
	 AND    PO_LINES_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID = PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID
	 AND
		(
		       PO_HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		AND    LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		)
	 
	 UNION ALL
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		)
		LOCATIONS_TMP,
		PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL
	 WHERE  
	 LINES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE  < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 AND   LINES_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID = LOCATIONS_TMP.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 ) TMP,

 PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL, 
 PO_RELEASES_ALL, 
 PO_LINES_ALL, 
 PO_HEADERS_ALL, 
 PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL , 
 PR_DATE, 
 CURRENCY_LST,
 PO_DOC_STYLE_HEADERS
 WHERE

WITH CURRENCY_LST AS
     (SELECT NVL(FSP.ORG_ID, -99) ORG_ID,
             GSB.CURRENCY_CODE
     FROM    FINANCIALS_SYSTEM_PARAMS_ALL FSP,
             GL_SETS_OF_BOOKS GSB
     WHERE   FSP.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID = GSB.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
     )
     ,
     PR_DATE AS
     (SELECT  PO_ACTION_HISTORY.OBJECT_ID,
              MAX(
                       CASE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'APPROVE'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       END) LAST_APPROVED_DATE,
              MIN(
                       CASE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'SUBMIT'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                WHEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE = 'IMPORT'
                                THEN PO_ACTION_HISTORY.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                       END) LAST_SUBMIT_DATE
     FROM     PO_ACTION_HISTORY
     WHERE    PO_ACTION_HISTORY.OBJECT_TYPE_CODE = 'REQUISITION'
     AND      PO_ACTION_HISTORY.ACTION_CODE IN ('APPROVE',
                                                'SUBMIT' ,
                                                'IMPORT')
     GROUP BY OBJECT_ID
     )

		    PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL HEADERS_ALL
	    WHERE   LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
	    AND     HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    
	    UNION ALL
	    
	    SELECT
  		   LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	    FROM   PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL LINES_ALL,
		   PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL HEADERS_ALL
	    WHERE  LINES_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = HEADERS_ALL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID
	    AND    HEADERS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE    < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    AND    LINES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE     >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	    )
	 
	 UNION
	 
	 SELECT
  		LINES_ALL.ROWID RW
	 FROM   (	 
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL,
		PO_RELEASES_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID       = PO_RELEASES_ALL.PO_RELEASE_ID
	 AND    LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE    < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 AND    PO_RELEASES_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
	 
	 UNION ALL
	 
	 SELECT
	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL,
		PO_HEADERS_ALL                     ,
		PO_LINES_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.PO_LINE_ID  = PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID
	 AND    PO_LINES_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID = PO_HEADERS_ALL.PO_HEADER_ID
	 AND
		(

		AND    LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE   < TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		)
	 
	 UNION ALL

	        LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID
	 FROM   PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL LOCATIONS_ALL
	 WHERE  LOCATIONS_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
		)
